note: Ceilings for tools/route-budget.mjs: what a fresh visitor downloads per route, service worker blocked, in the published sources and a build. Each is the value measured at measuredAt plus 0.5% of its bytes and one request. Tight on purpose. The four lesson routes were lowered again when every remaining instrument family was made lazy, measured at the commit that did it (the lessonsMeasuredAt field): in the published sources, where each family is its own module with its own imports, importing any one family eagerly again puts every lesson over its ceiling. A bundle can absorb a small family inside the slack, which is why e2e/lazyInstruments.spec.js, not these numbers, is what holds every lesson to the families its steps name. The other routes did not move and kept the ceilings measured at measuredAt. Raised only by hand, in a commit that says why. The instructor-portal ceilings were re-pinned the same way when the GWOSC lab added 5.2 KB of instructor guidance to that page (767.4 KB sources, 646.6 KB build), approved by the owner; no other route moved. The evaluation page's ceilings are measured after merging v2 at 489e4d2, where #36 made js/evaluationKit.js write through the shared js/csv.js (the spreadsheet-formula guard, 7.1 KB as served): 30.5 KB in 3 requests from the sources, 11.6 KB in 1 from the build. The figure builder's ceilings (/figure/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it; they include its live preview, which is the embed application itself, so most of the page's weight is the figure it shows. The experiment runner's ceilings (/experiments/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it (1103.5 KB in 46 requests from the sources, 323.6 KB in 2 from the build): the page prices an experiment as it opens by building one trial in a Worker and timing a short burst of it there, so the route carries the engine that Worker imports - in the build that is the Worker's own bundle, one file. The 46th request is js/csv.js, the shared writer the trials CSV goes through for its formula guard (7.4 KB as served). The observatory's ceilings (/observatory/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it (252.3 KB in 28 requests from the sources, 119.4 KB in 2 from the build): the page before any observation is opened. Each observation is fetched only when opened, and tools/observatory-budgets.json holds what each adds. They were lowered with the inference core's fit panel, measured on the commit that added it (193.7 KB in 19 requests from the sources, 97.9 KB in 2 from the build). The panel itself is a lazy chunk and costs the page nothing; the room came from js/observatory/fixtures.js loading its packs from js/platform/builtins.js rather than through js/platform/resolver.js, whose import installs every packaged lesson's loaders and had been bringing the investigations manifest to a page that never uses it (22 KB of the build, 60 KB and 9 requests of the sources). Lowered again with the curated catalog (Prompt 17), measured on the commit that added it (188.7 KB in 18 requests from the sources, 96.7 KB in 2 from the build): the pack decoder (js/observation.js) now arrives with the first observation opened, and opening an installed pack loads its own module only when the page is opened from the catalog. Lowered again with the stellar-populations suite (Prompt 25), measured on the commit that did it (174.4 KB in 16 requests from the sources, 85.9 KB in 3 from the build): the page's Spanish catalog now loads only for a reader who arrives in Spanish or chooses it (js/observatory/i18n.js loadLanguage), which paid for the suite's derived columns, table fixtures and model overlays on the page and left 12 KB of the old ceiling unused; a reader who opens in Spanish downloads 12.9 KB more, in one more request. The catalog's ceilings (/catalog/) were added with the page, measured on the same commit (81.2 KB in 12 requests from the sources, 36.2 KB in 1 from the build): the page with the catalog's index loaded; an archive is fetched only when installed. The four lesson routes were raised by hand for the lesson-markup fix (fix/lesson-prose-entities), by exactly what it adds to each, measured against v2 at 4351077 and rounded up to 0.1 KB: 3,088 bytes in one more request from the sources, where js/lessonMarkup.js is a module of its own, and 726 bytes in no more requests from the build, where it shares the chunk js/answerCheck.js is in. The panel now decodes the entities it shows, so the entity table and its decoder are on every lesson's path. The change measured inside the old ceilings before #79 to #81 landed; they left the build routes 69 to 140 bytes of room, less than any decoder costs. The request ceilings did not move. The Scenario Studio's ceilings (/studio/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it (936 KB in 39 requests from the sources, 215.4 KB in 3 from the build): the page before its preview is asked for. It checks a scenario with the modules the application builds it with - the settings, the scenarios, the Orbital System Builder's checks and the integrator list from js/physics.js - which is most of its weight; the preview, loaded only when pressed, is the embed application itself. The Investigation Composer's ceilings (/studio/lesson/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it (469.6 KB in 29 requests from the sources, 246.4 KB in 12 from the build): the page with the example investigation checked, which fetches the lesson checker (js/authoring/rules.js). The instrument registry is not on that path - importing it fetches both deferred catalogs of words - and arrives only when a step docks an instrument. The 3-D dynamics diagnostics page's ceilings (/lab3d/) were added with the page, measured on the commit that added it (125 KB in 12 requests from the sources, 38.1 KB in 1 from the build): the page before a run. The 3-D kernel is not on that path; it arrives in the run's Worker, which a visitor who runs nothing never fetches.
